name: Smart Diff groups Files changed by role and Original order returns GitHub's order
description: PR #482 → Files changed tab: each agent's newest review's findings show as per-severity role-group counters on Core, then Original order flattens the groups and is kept in ?order=. Runs last (lexical order): flows 09/11 (E2E_MOCK_LLM) may add a review, which changes the counts, so the counter assertion accepts any '● N' and the flow doesn't depend on run order. The PR list defaults to 'Needs review', which flows 09/11 make it fail (PR now 'reviewed'), so this flow clicks 'All' first, like flows 10/11. Read-only for this flow (no model call of its own).

steps.label: tall viewport: the PR page scrolls inside <main>, which agent-browser's click does not scroll
PR list: show All (chip reads 'All · N'; flows 09/11 may have left the PR 'reviewed', hidden by the default 'Needs review' filter)
